what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in South Africa, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 17931 Somali refugees in South Africa, 2.0% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia from 1989 to 1996, in 2001 to 2002 and in every year from 2006 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
From 2006 the government's opponents it records include ARS/UIC, Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 96 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 41458, at the end of 2015, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2013 to 2024.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
These are year-end totals for South Africa only, reported to UNHCR.
